actions.text: Removes a queue item by id, with query options removalMethod, blocklistMethod and an optional message. A pending release is removed and blocklisted if requested.
If the id is not a pending release, the matching tracked download is removed according to removalMethod and blocklistMethod, then it stops being tracked.

rules.text: removalMethod and blocklistMethod are both required; a missing one gives a bad request ('removalMethod must be provided' or 'blocklistMethod must be provided').
The pending releases are checked first; only if none matches the id is the queue and tracked downloads looked up.
A not-found error is raised if the queue item or its tracked download is not found.
A pending release is blocklisted unless blocklistMethod is DoNotBlocklist. The default message is 'Pending release manually blocklisted'.

With removalMethod RemoveFromClient, the item is removed from the download client with its data deleted. With ChangeCategory, it is marked as imported in the client. A missing download client gives a bad request.
Marking an item as imported throws 'does not support marking items as imported' unless the client overrides it.

Marking as failed requires grabbed history for the download; otherwise it fails with 'Unable to mark download as failed, no grabbed history available'. The default message is 'Manually marked as failed'.

A tracked download is ignored only when removalMethod is Ignore and blocklisting is not requested. If the series is unknown, ignoring logs a warning and does nothing; the request still stops tracking and returns 204.
Skip-redownload is set on failure marking only when blocklistMethod is BlocklistOnly.
The request source recorded is the X-Sonarr-Client header if present, otherwise it comes from the User-Agent, or 'Other'.

shows.text: Returns 204 No Content when the queue item is removed, or 404 Not Found when no matching queue item or tracked download exists.

sideEffects.text: Blocklisting a pending release inserts a blocklist record with series, episodes, release details, message and source.
Removing a pending release deletes all pending releases of that series with the same season and episode numbers.
Ignoring a download publishes a DownloadIgnoredEvent with message 'Manually ignored', handled by the download history and history services.
Stopping tracking removes the download from the tracked-download cache and publishes a TrackedDownloadsRemovedEvent, handled by the download monitoring service.

findings.explanation: When the series is unknown, IgnoreDownload only logs a warning and returns false. Remove then returns null. Nothing throws or fails. RemoveAction goes on to stop tracking and return 204. The word 'fails' is not supported.
findings.reason: Reworded: unknown series only logs a warning and returns false; the request continues to stop tracking and return 204. Removed 'fails'.
findings.statementText: A tracked download is ignored only when removalMethod is Ignore and blocklisting is not requested. Ignoring does nothing and fails if the series is unknown.
